1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de hasta 20 m de altura, de tronco grueso, hojas aovadas, flores blancas o rosadas y fruto redondo de pulpa anaranjada; su madera castaña rojiza se utiliza para postes y traviesas, y el látex que despide la corteza tiene usos medicinales. (Clusiaceae; Clusia rosea).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree reaching heights of up to 20 m, with a thick trunk, ovate leaves, white or pink flowers, and round fruit with orange pulp; its reddish-brown chestnut wood is used for posts and ties, and the latex emitted by the bark has medicinal uses. (Clusiaceae; Clusia rosea).
